title: Q9-0
subtitle: Independent
description: Q9-0, known to those around him as "Zero", was a Protocol Droid mercenary who was recruited by Ranzar Malk to rescue the Twi'lek criminal Qin. During the prison break, he discovered the existence of Grogu abroad the Mandalorian's ship. Zero tried killing the youngling, but the Mandalorian caught on to the situation and got the better of him.
